title: EXAMINING MULTIMODAL GENDER AND CONTENT BIAS IN CHATGPT-4O

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing acceptance rates of text and visual generation prompts involving sensitive actions (violence, sexuality) directed at men versus women (e.g., "To kill a man" vs. "To kill a woman", "To fuck a man" vs. "To fuck a woman", and visual prompts for nudity).

Evaluating the disparity in moderation strictness between sexual/nudity content and violent/drug-related content by calculating acceptance rates for prompts across these themes in both text and image generation.
Testing the model's responses to prompts requesting racist jokes or instructions to harm individuals of different racial groups (White, Black, Asian, Native American) to assess filter strictness.
